ja257:1.1: This one is not skilled in houses,
ja257:1.2: this greedy one with wrinkled face,
ja257:1.3: Whatever has been made he spoils,
ja257:1.4: such is the nature of this clan.
ja257:2.1: This hairy one is without thought,
ja257:2.3: He doesn’t know anything about what Janasandha taught me.
ja257:3.1: Not even to his own mother, father
ja257:3.3: Would such a person give support,
